ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 5.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe tip displays high-intensity cluster (x:0-60); four distinct vertical white striations at x:120-220. Right lobe displays complex geometric high-intensity network including chevron-like patterns and a dense patch at the distal tip (x:780-980).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 54 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across 100% of the trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys ranges from 8 to 18 pixels relative to local peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous concave curve fitted to the trailing edge trailing from distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) detected at the far-left distal tip (x:15, y:120) and scattered within the right lobe's white patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); vertical orientation on the left lobe (x:130-210) and diagonal/chevron orientation on the right lobe (x:790-940).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; significant irregular chipping and jagged erosion across the entire trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique chevron-shaped (zig-zag) high-intensity pigmentation pattern located on the interior portion of the right lobe.
